achievement.1.description: May mata ka sa mga kahina-hinalang lugar at mahilig kang magbasa ng mga diary ng ibang tao, lalo na iyong may mga kwentong bampira. Isa ka ring dedikadong token collector at explorer. Respeto!
achievement.1.name: [EN] Castlemania
achievement.10.description: Sinusundan mo ang landas ng mga pangarap at ng responsibilidad nang walang kapangyarihang nakasentro sa sarili. Malaya sa kasakiman at pagkamakasarili, tinutulungan mo ang iba nang hindi umaasa ng gantimpala.
achievement.10.name: [EN] Nightmare Knight
achievement.100.description: Ilang bagay ang katumbas ng matinding galit ng isang nakulong at riven na nilalang. Ikaw ay isang karapat-dapat na kalaban.
achievement.100.name: [EN] Slayer of Irahsae
achievement.101.description: Ang bulag na poot ay nagkaroon ng pisikal na anyo, marahas na nagrerebelde laban sa kawalang-katarungan kung saan ipinanganak ito. Hindi mo nagawang magdala ng hustisya - ngunit pansamantalang kapayapaan.
achievement.101.name: Slayer ng Phrodomo
achievement.102.description: Ang ipinagbabawal na kaalaman ng mga aeon ay hindi kailanman sinadya upang salakayin ang mundong ito. Pinatahimik mo ang boses nito bago pa ito marinig.
achievement.102.name: Slayer ng Teneshpar
achievement.103.description: Nakatulong ka sa pagpapababa sa mga mapanganib na galamay ni Devovorga at sa kanyang napakalaking cocoon - hindi huminto sa kanyang pagbabago, ngunit sa huli ay nakumpleto ang isang mahalagang hakbang sa kanyang kamatayan.
achievement.103.name: Cocoon ng Doom
achievement.104.description: Isang espesyal na bayani sa marami. Ngayong taon - ikaw iyon. Si Devovorga ay umatras sa isang mas madilim na kaharian dahil hindi niya nakayanan ang iyong kapangyarihan - at ng iyong mga kasama. Sasabihin ng oras kung maganda ang pinili mo - ngunit sa ngayon, iniligtas nito ang iyong mundo.
achievement.104.name: [EN] Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: Pagod... pagod na pagod... ang pagkulot sa isang mainit at maaliwalas na kama ay tila ang perpektong bagay na dapat gawin ngayon. Matamis na panaginip!
achievement.105.name: [EN] Mister Sandman
achievement.106.description: Natutulog - ginagawa mo ito nang may istilo. Nanlamig ka sa iyong duyan, nakikinig sa huni ng mga ibon at kuliglig habang unti-unti kang inaanod palayo sa larangan ng mga pangarap.
achievement.106.name: [EN] Rock Me to Sleep
achievement.107.description: Hindi mo kailangan ng marami para makatulog nang kumportable. Ang isang tumpok ng dayami at isang bubong sa iyong ulo - na ang huli ay ganap na opsyonal - ay sapat na upang makapagpahinga. Hindi mo alintana ang mga daga na kumagat sa iyong mga daliri sa paa.
achievement.107.name: Mahinhin na Panauhin
achievement.108.description: Buweno - ang mga nilalaman ng regalong iyon ay hindi tulad ng iyong inaasahan. Sa mga kaibigang tulad nito, sino ang nangangailangan ng mga kaaway?
achievement.108.name: [EN] Joke's on You
achievement.109.description: Sobra para sa iyong mabalahibong maliit na kaibigan! Siguro nakatayo sa harap ng kulungan ng ibon, pinipisil ang leeg nito at sumisigaw ng 'Kumanta! kumanta! kumanta!' ay medyo sobra para dito?!
achievement.109.name: Oops
achievement.11.description: Sumali ka sa undead bone brothers - ginawa mong kaaway mo at sandata mo rin ang kamatayan. Ang paglamon sa kung ano ang mahina at pag-iiwan ng espasyo para sa kung ano ang malakas ang iyong pangunahing layunin.
achievement.11.name: Kapatid na buto
achievement.110.description: Nabubuhay ka sa buhay ng mga mangangaso at mangangaso. Buweno, lalo na sa isang nagtitipon, at lalo na sa isang nagtitipon ng maraming blueberries. Nasuri mo na ba ang kulay ng iyong dila kamakailan?
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: Makapal, pula - inalog, hindi hinalo - at may straw sa loob nito: iyan ang paraan na mas gusto mo ang iyong dugo ng demonyo. Hinahain na may onion ring, ang banayad na metal na aftertaste ay halos hindi napapansin. Malugod na tinatanggap ang mga kapaki-pakinabang na epekto sa kalusugan o mana.
achievement.111.name: [EN] Demonic Barkeeper
achievement.112.description: Gusto mo ang taglamig. Ganap na nilagyan ng scarf at guwantes, gusto mong magsaya sa labas habang gumagawa ng maraming snowmen kasama ang iyong mga kaibigan. Labanan ng snowball, sinuman?
achievement.112.name: Ang taong yari sa niyebe
achievement.113.name: Bilang ng Halimaw
achievement.114.description: Ikaw at ang iyong mga palaman na mabalahibong kaibigan ay hindi mapaghihiwalay, at hindi ka nahihiyang dalhin sila sa kama - sino ang nakakaalam kung kailan ka magigising sa kalagitnaan ng gabi na nangangailangan ng yakap?
achievement.114.name: Kailangan ko ng Yakap
achievement.115.description: Okay, aminin natin - hangga't naniniwala ka na posibleng maghatid sa iyo sa pinakamalaking kayamanan kailanman, hindi mo bibitawan ang mapa na iyon, gaano man ito kapangani. Dapat may sekreto sa likod ng lahat ng ito!
achievement.115.name: [EN] Slim Chance
achievement.116.description: Alinman sa hindi ka mabilis na nag-aaral o nakahanap ka ng kasiyahan sa pagsunog ng iyong sarili. O naghahanap ka lang ng magarbong pamagat. Sa anumang kaso, dapat mong malaman na ang pagpasa ng gas sa panahon ng iyong maliit na mga eksperimento sa asno ay hindi inirerekomenda.
achievement.116.name: Rocket sa Pocket
achievement.117.description: Ngunit ipikit ang iyong mga mata at huwag sabihin sa sinuman kung ano ang iyong naisin, o hindi ito magkatotoo!
achievement.117.name: Gumawa ng isang Wish
achievement.118.description: Ang Pasko ay ang iyong paboritong oras ng taon, at anak, mahilig ka ba sa mga regalo. Bumili ng ilang magagandang bagay para sa iyong mga kaibigan, itago ang mga ito hanggang sa - mabuti, hanggang sa magpasya kang aktuwal na buksan ang mga ito sa halip na ikaw mismo.
achievement.118.name: Ang Li'l Helper ni Santa
achievement.119.description: Ang galit ng Noxious Spawn - hindi mo sinasadyang natamo ito. Ang iyong mga araw ay binibilang at ang iyong kamatayan ay hindi maiiwasan. minsan. Sa isang lugar.
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.12.description: Nilakbay mo ang mundo para sa halos walang kabuluhang panalangin - ngunit hindi mo na kailangang gawin iyon muli at maaari kang makakuha ng isang bagong pinagpalang stake sa isang kisap-mata.
achievement.12.name: Pinagpala!
achievement.120.description: Yay! Finders keepers, losers weepers! Sino ang nagmamalasakit kung saan nanggaling ang lahat ng bagay na iyon at kung kailangan mong gumapang sa mga tambak ng basura upang makuha ito? Ito ay LIBRE!
achievement.120.name: Libreng Item!
achievement.121.description: Pataas at pababa at pataas at pababa... at pagkatapos ay ang malaking looping! Maghintay - hindi sila gumagawa ng mga loop sa Kazordoon. Pero masaya pa rin ang ore wagon rides!
achievement.121.name: [EN] Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: Ikaw, Sir o Ginang, ay isang tunay na alchemist. Ang pagsasagawa ng transmutating na mga eksperimento upang mahanap ang bawat posibleng kumbinasyon ay ang iyong sikretong hilig mula noong mga taon at ang mga resulta ng iyong pananaliksik ay hindi kapani-paniwala. Ang agham ay tumalon lamang salamat sa iyo!
achievement.122.name: [EN] Transmutator
achievement.123.description: RAWR! Lakas na dumadaloy sa iyong katawan, mas mabilis ang tibok ng iyong puso at pinalalakas ng adrenaline ang bawat pag-indayog ng iyong armas. Lahat sa isang maliit na bote. Walang refund para sa mga nawasak na kasangkapan. Para sa karagdagang mga katanungan kumonsulta sa iyong manggagamot o nagbebenta ng gayuma.
achievement.123.name: Nakakabaliw
achievement.124.description: Pakiramdam mo ay malulutas mo ang pinakamahirap na bugtong sa loob ng isang minuto o higit pa. Dagdag pa, mayroong magandang tulong sa iyong pinsala sa spell. Lahat sa isang maliit na bote. Mga epekto - pakiramdam ng bahagyang hangal. Para sa karagdagang mga katanungan kumonsulta sa iyong manggagamot o nagbebenta ng gayuma.
achievement.124.name: Utak
achievement.125.description: Pinahusay na paningin, mga arrow at bolts na lumilipad sa bilis ng liwanag at pini-pin ang iyong mga kaaway na may dagdag na pinsala. Lahat sa isang maliit na bote. Walang kinakailangang pagkonsumo ng mga karot. Para sa karagdagang mga katanungan kumonsulta sa iyong manggagamot o nagbebenta ng gayuma.
achievement.125.name: [EN] Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: Urgh! Isara ang mga bintana! Isara ang araw na nagpapalaki sa kanyang pangit na dilaw na ulo, isara ang nakakarinig na tawa ng mga anak ng iyong kapitbahay. Ahhh. Yakapin ang matamis na kadiliman at katahimikan.
achievement.126.name: Huwag Istorbohin
achievement.127.description: Bumangon at sumikat! Ito ay isang magandang bagong araw - buksan ang iyong mga bintana, pakiramdam ang mainit na sikat ng araw, panoorin ang mga ibon na kumakanta sa iyong windowsill at alagaan ang iyong mga halaman. Anong dahilan para hindi maging masaya?
achievement.127.name: Hayaan ang Sunshine In
achievement.128.description: Argh! Hindi ngayon! Paanong ang mga multifunctional na tool na iyon ay hindi kailanman nabigo kapag ginagamit mo ang mga ito para sa isang bagay na ganap na walang halaga tulad ng pagpiga ng juice, ngunit nagugulo kapag kailangan mong umakyat sa isang lubid na may isang dragon na humihinga ng apoy na humahabol sa iyo?
achievement.128.name: Masamang Timing
achievement.129.description: Tinatawanan mo ang hindi handa na mga adventurer na natigil sa matataas na damo o rush wood. O baka naman tinutulungan mo talaga sila. Tinatawag ka nilang... 'Machete'.
achievement.129.name: Walang Makapipigil sa Akin
achievement.13.description: Isa kang mahuhusay na mangangalakal na may kakayahang pangasiwaan ang mga paninda nang may pag-iingat, nakahanap ng magagandang alok at naghuhukay ng mga bihirang paminsan-minsan. Hindi kailanman nahuhuli upang kumpletuhin ang isang order, ikaw ay isang maaasahang mangangalakal - kahit na sa mata ni Rashid.
achievement.13.name: Kinikilalang Trader
achievement.130.description: Umindayog ang Scythe sa iyong balikat, sumisikat ang araw sa iyong likuran - isa kang pusong magsasaka at mahilig magtrabaho sa bukid. O kaya naman, baka gumawa ka lang ng magarbong crop circle para takutin ang kapwa mo lalaki.
achievement.130.name: Maligayang Magsasaka
achievement.131.description: Ang Liberty Bay ay ang perpektong tambayan para sa iyo at ang pag-aani ng tubo ay isang nakakarelaks na aktibidad sa paglilibang. Gusto mo ba ng tsaa na may asukal, hon?
achievement.131.name: Natural na Pangpatamis
achievement.132.description: Yo-ho-ho at isang bote ng rum - gawa sa bahay, siyempre, mula sa pinili at personal na ani na mga halaman ng tubo. Ngayon, hayaan itong tumanda sa isang oak barrel at tamasahin ito sa loob ng halos 10 taon. O para sa mga naiinip: Taraaarty tayo ngayon din!
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: Mga nakatagong kayamanan sa ilalim ng mga buhangin ng disyerto - mayroon kang ilong para mahanap ang mga ito at alam mo kung saan maghukay. Maaaring hindi ka nila pinayaman, ngunit makintab at maganda sila kahit papaano.
achievement.133.name: [EN] Gold Digger
achievement.134.description: Ikaw at ang iyong pala - isang tugma na ginawa sa langit. O impiyerno, para sa bagay na iyon. Sa isang lugar sa ibaba sa anumang kaso. Naaakit ka sa mga tambak na bato at gustong-gusto mong buksan ang mga ito at makita kung saan ka dadalhin ng mga butas na iyon. Magandang biceps din.
achievement.134.name: Ang Undertaker
achievement.135.description: Madali kang mahahanap ng sinuman kung susunod lang sila sa cookie crumb trail. At para sa iyo, ang ibig sabihin ng tunay na pag-ibig ay ibigay ang iyong huling cookie.
achievement.135.name: [EN] Cookie Monster
achievement.136.description: At sinumang nag-aangkin ng iba ay sinungaling.
achievement.136.name: Ang Cake ang Katotohanan
achievement.137.description: Ang sikat na 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' ay malamang na isinulat mo. Ang paggugol ng maulan na hapon sa harap ng tsimenea, na nakabalot sa isang kumot habang nagpapakasawa sa cocoa delights ay parang isang bagay na gagawin mo. Enjoy!
achievement.137.name: Sweet tooth
achievement.138.description: Gusto mo ang iyong cake na malambot, na may fruity bits at magandang sugar icing. At mas gusto mong gawin ang mga ito sa iyong sarili. Naisipan mo na bang magbukas ng panaderya? Magaling ka na talaga ngayon!
achievement.138.name: May Cherry sa Itaas
achievement.139.description: Muahahaha ito ay isang... mutated pumpkin! Pagkatapos tumulong na alisin ito - tumulong ka, hindi ba? - inangkin mo ang iyong gantimpala at nakakuha ng higit pa o hindi gaanong kakaibang regalo. Maligayang Halloween!
achievement.139.name: [EN] Mutated Presents
achievement.14.description: Natagpuan mo at humigop mula sa Fountain of Life. Akala mo hindi ito nagbigay sa iyo ng buhay na walang hanggan, pakiramdam mo ay nagbago at kahit papaano ay payapa.
achievement.14.name: Bukal ng Buhay
achievement.140.description: Isa sa mga Lightbearers. Isa sa mga tumulong upang panatilihing nasusunog ang mga palanggana at nagtulungan laban sa kadiliman. Ang mga bulong ng demonyo sa likod ng manipis na tabing sa pagitan ng mga mundo - muli silang napatahimik salamat sa iyong tulong.
achievement.140.name: Tagabantay ng Alab
achievement.141.description: Isa ka sa pinaka-dedikadong Lightbearer - kung wala ka, tiyak na mapunit ng mga demonyo ang belo sa pagitan ng mga mundo. Nailawan mo ang bawat isa at bawat palanggana, naglalakbay nang mataas at mababa, itinutulak pabalik ang hindi makamundong pwersa. Magkaroon ng liwanag!
achievement.141.name: Tunay na Lightbearer
achievement.142.description: Natalo mo ang mga pagkakatawang-tao ng Snake God at, sa huling malakas na pag-indayog ng sceptre ng ahas, pinutol mo ang supply ng kanyang life force. Ang kwento ng kapangyarihan, panlilinlang at katiwalian ay natapos na - o... hindi?
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: Uhm... sino yung taong kakagising mo lang? Mga basag na baso ng cocktail sa sahig, mga bulaklak sa buong kwarto, at bakit ka nakasuot ng singsing? Ang kahapon ay dapat na isang mahaba, kakaibang araw...
achievement.143.name: Ang Araw Pagkatapos
achievement.144.description: Ang pangmatagalang relasyon ay hindi lang para sa iyo. At sa tuwing iniisip mong umiibig ka, napatunayang mali ka pagkatapos. O baka napupunta ka lang sa maling manliligaw sa bawat pagkakataon - pinagsamantalahan at pinagtaksilan. Ang manatiling walang asawa ay maaaring mas mabuti.
achievement.144.name: Pangako Phobic
achievement.145.description: Tiwala? Pag-ibig? Katapatan? Pah! Antiquated sentiments. Hangga't ikaw ay may kasiyahan, hindi mo alintana ang pagtapak sa maraming puso. Mas mabuti habang nakasuot ng combat boots.
achievement.145.name: Nakakadurog ng puso
achievement.146.description: Espesyalidad mo ang stealth kills at backstabbing. Ang iyong maraming biktima ay karaniwang walang kamalayan sa kanilang nalalapit na kamatayan, na dinadala mo sa kanila nang tahimik at mabilis. Lahat ay pinahihintulutan.
achievement.146.name: Mabilis na Kamatayan
achievement.147.description: Ano ang pinakamaganda sa buhay? Upang durugin ang iyong mga kaaway. Upang makita silang nauna sa iyo. At para siguro magkaroon ng masarap na tasa ng tsaa pagkatapos.
achievement.147.name: Brutal na Kagalang-galang
achievement.148.description: Ikaw ay isang pulubi, walang tirahan, nakasuot ng maruruming damit. Ngunit hindi iyon nangangahulugan na kailangan mong humingi ng kahit na sino para sa mga bagay-bagay - at iningatan mo pa rin ang iyong pagmamataas. Ang mga pinong balahibo ay hindi kinakailangang gumawa ng magagandang ibon - kung ano ang nasa ilalim ng mga ito ay mas mahalaga.
achievement.148.name: Buhay sa Kalye
achievement.149.description: Suot ang insignia at maitim na damit ng Brotherhood of Bones gumala ka sa mga lupain na nagkakalat ng takot at sakit, na lumilikha ng mga bagong sundalo para sa necromantic na hukbo na malapit nang bumangon. Aba sa Kapatiran.
achievement.149.name: Bungo at Buto
achievement.15.description: Naglakbay ka sa surreal na kaharian ng mga elemental na globo, ipinatawag at pinatay ang Panginoon ng mga Elemento, lahat para makuha ang neutral na bagay. At kahit gaano ka katapang, hindi mo ito magagawa kung wala ang iyong koponan!
achievement.15.name: Panginoon ng mga Elemento
achievement.150.description: Hindi ka natatakot sa mga bangungot, naglalakbay ka sa mga ito - nahaharap sa hindi mabilang na mga kakila-kilabot at nilalabanan ang kapalaran na kanilang dadalhin. Iilan lang ang naniniwala sa madilim na mga propesiya na ibinalik mo mula sa mga panaginip na iyon, ngunit ang mga nakikipaglaban sa tabi mo bilang Nightmare Knights.
achievement.150.name: [EN] Nightmare Walker
achievement.151.description: Dapat ipagmalaki ng bawat lungsod na tawagin ang isang tulad mo bilang naninirahan dito. Pinapanatili mong malinis ang mga kalye at tumulong kang ayusin ang mga karaniwang hindi pagkakaunawaan sa harap ng depot. Gayundin, malamang na nagmamay-ari ka ng pusa at mahilig mag-hiking.
achievement.151.name: Ulirang Mamamayan
achievement.152.description: Hindi mo dinadala ang stake na iyon para lang sa dekorasyon - handa ka nang gamitin ito. Kadalasan ay makikita kang nagha-hightail sa pinakamalalim na piitan na nag-iiwan ng bakas ng mga napatay na demonyo. Ang sinumang maglakas-loob na humarang sa iyong daraanan ay dapat maghanda na mamatay.
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: Isa sa kalikasan, isa sa wildlife. Hilaw at makahayop na kapangyarihan, matalas na pandama, umaangal sa pinakamataas na bangin at umaatungal sa pinakamakapal na kagubatan - ikaw iyon.
achievement.153.name: Ng mga Lobo at Oso
achievement.154.description: Sa araw ay makikita kang naka-camouflage sa kakahuyan na naglalagay ng mga bitag o naghahabol sa malaking laro, sa gabi ay nakaupo ka sa tabi ng apoy sa kampo at nagbabahagi ng iyong mga kuwento sa pangangaso. Kinakain mo ang hinuhuli mo at isinusuot mo ang binalatan mo. Ang buhay ay maaaring magpatuloy nang ganoon magpakailanman.
achievement.154.name: Pangangaso gamit ang Estilo
achievement.155.description: At tandaan: Huwag subukang turuan ang isang baboy na kumanta. Ito ay nag-aaksaya ng iyong oras at nakakainis sa baboy.
achievement.155.name: Loko kay Heart
achievement.156.description: May talim na talim at kumpleto sa gamit sa isang matibay na full plate armor, sinisingil mo ang iyong mga kaaway nang may parehong lakas at tapang. Palaging may isang dalagang ililigtas at isang dragon na papatayin para sa iyo.
achievement.156.name: Sa Shining Armor
achievement.157.description: Sinisimulan mo ang iyong araw sa pamamagitan ng pagligo sa iyong palayok ng ginto at hindi mo iniisip na ipakita ang iyong kayamanan habang naglalakad sa mga lansangan sa iyong pinakamahusay na mga damit - pagkatapos ng lahat ito ay ang iyong pinaghirapang pera! Mas gusto mong tawagan ng 'Your Highness'.
achievement.157.name: Aristocrat
achievement.158.description: Ang mga tambak ng niyebe at bagyo ay hindi makakapigil sa iyo mula sa kung saan mo gustong pumunta. Perpektong gamit ka para sa anumang ekspedisyon sa walang hanggang yelo at alam mo kung paano panatilihing mainit ang iyong mga paa. Kung ikaw ay isang babae, iyon ay isang tagumpay din.
achievement.158.name: Out sa Snowstorm
achievement.159.description: Pakiramdam mo ay nasa bahay ka sa ilalim ng mainit na araw ng disyerto na may buhangin sa pagitan ng iyong mga daliri sa paa, at ang iyong paboritong paraan ng paglalakbay ay isang lumilipad na karpet. Gayundin, maaari mong gawin ang head isolation dance move na iyon.
achievement.159.name: Isang Libo at Isa
achievement.16.description: Ginawa mong muli ang Taming of the Shrew sa isang beach setting at napatunayan mong kaya mong panghawakan ang mga pabagu-bagong babae. Mayroon man o walang buntot ng isda.
achievement.16.name: [EN] Beach Tamer
achievement.160.description: Kayo ay isang maginoo o 'swerte, fightin' at carousin' sa mataas na dagat, out fer nadambong at lassies! Hindi ka sasagutin ng sinuman o sabog na monarkiya at ang iyong buhay ay hindi fer ang lily-livered. Ay, matey!
achievement.160.name: [EN] Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: Ang pag-alog ng iyong kalansing at pagsasayaw sa paligid ng apoy sa mga tambol ng gubat ay parang gusto mong gawin. Bukod pa rito, ang dreadlocks ay isang maginhawang paraan upang isuot ang iyong buhok - hindi kailangan ng pagsusuklay!
achievement.161.name: Daan ng Shaman
achievement.162.description: Maaaring ikaw ang may-akda ng magnum opus na 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. O, kung ang iyong isip at puso ay dalisay, mas pipiliin mo ang mga nilalang upang tumulong sa iba. O baka isang maliit na pusa lang para may kayakap.
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: Hindi ka natatakot na ipakita ang iyong mga kulay sa init ng labanan. Kinatatakutan ng mga kalaban ang iyong nakamamatay na sibat at hindi malalampasan na baluti. Ang listahan ng mga digmaang napanalunan mo ay kahanga-hanga. Mabuhay at pumatay!
achievement.163.name: Master ng Digmaan
achievement.164.description: Ang kagitingan ay para sa mga mahihina - hindi mahalaga kung paano ka manalo sa labanan, basta ikaw ay mananalo. Ang makapal na baluti ay hahadlang lamang sa iyong mga galaw, kaya pinapanatili mo itong magaan at umaasa sa bilis at kasanayan sa halip na magtago sa isang hindi komportable na shell.
achievement.164.name: [EN] Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: Isa kang hamak na mandirigma na hindi nangangailangan ng yaman o espesyal na kagamitan para sa paglalakbay at pakikipaglaban. Pakiramdam mo ay nasa tahanan ka sa hilagang lupain ng Zao at ginawa mo ang iyong bahagi sa paglaban sa katiwalian nito.
achievement.165.name: [EN] Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: Ang iyong mga gawa para sa Yalahar ay karaniwang nailalarawan sa pamamagitan ng malalim na pananaw at maalalahanin na mga aksyon. Salamat sa iyo, maaaring magkaroon ng pagkakataon si Yalahar na umunlad nang mapayapa at kasama ang mga masasayang taong naninirahan dito.
achievement.166.name: Yalahari ng Karunungan
achievement.167.description: Ipagtanggol mo ang Yalahar nang may malupit na puwersa at handang pangunahan ito sa isang maluwalhating labanan, kung kinakailangan. Salamat sa iyo, magiging sapat na makapangyarihan si Yalahar upang tumayo laban sa sinumang kaaway.
achievement.167.name: Yalahari ng Kapangyarihan
achievement.168.description: Ang buhay ay maaaring maging napakadali gamit ang tamang cake sa tamang oras - at pinagkadalubhasaan mo ang pagluluto ng maraming iba't ibang mga cake, kaya dapat kang maging handa para sa halos lahat ng bagay na napagpasyahan ng buhay na ihagis sa iyo.
achievement.168.name: Piraso ng Cake
achievement.169.description: Itinuturing kang first-rate na nagtapos ng Magic Academy sa Edron dahil sa iyong mga pangunguna na pagtuklas at matagumpay na pag-aaral sa larangan ng experimental magic at spell development. Naisip mo na bang ituro ang Armagedon spell?
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.17.description: Kapag gumawa ka ng isang bagay, gagawin mo ito ng tama. Mayroon kang opinyon at pinaninindigan mo ito - at walang sinuman ang makakumbinsi sa iyo kung hindi man. Sa sidenote, medyo nasa brutal at war-oriented ka side, pero hindi naman masama iyon, di ba?
achievement.17.name: Tagasunod ni Azerus
achievement.170.description: Marunong ka sa mas madidilim na paraan ng mahika at kadalasang makikita kang nakaupo sa loob ng bilog ng mga kandila at bungo na bumubulong ng mga salitang hindi masabi. Huwag masyadong magdala ng mga gamit at baka dumating ang mga demonyo sa iyo.
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: Sa katunayan, mayroon kang malambot na lugar para sa mga kuneho. Marahil ang mga kuneho na iniligtas mo ngayon ay ang mga kuneho na magliligtas sa iyo bukas. Kapag gutom ka na talaga.
achievement.171.name: Nadulas si Bunny
achievement.172.description: Alam ng mga tunay na siyentipiko ang kanilang kagamitan. Ang pagsubok ng mga bagong imbensyon ay mahalagang araw-araw na gawain para sa sinumang masipag na mananaliksik. Hindi ka nagpakita ng takot at kinuha ang lahat ng bagong kagamitan mula sa Spectulus at Sinclair para sa isang pag-ikot.
achievement.172.name: Guinea Pig
achievement.173.description: Pumunta ka sa kagubatan, nakilala si Rottin Wood at ang mga Kasal na Lalaki at tinulungan sila sa kanilang kampo. Oh, at huwag mag-alala tungkol sa mga mangangalakal na iyon. Hindi sila maglalakas-loob na banggitin ang kakaibang malalaking halaga ng ginto na aktwal nilang taglay na nawawala ngayon.
achievement.173.name: Maligayang Pakikipagsapalaran
achievement.174.description: Naipasa mo ang kanilang pagsusulit at tumulong sa mga kagamitan sa pagsubok ng Spirithunters, nagsasaliksik sa mga supernatural at nakakahuli ng mga multo - ikaw ang tatawagan nila.
achievement.174.name: Takot walang Multo!
achievement.175.description: Halos lahat ng mga halaman na sinubukan mo para sa Chartan sa Zao kung saan hindi nakakain - natikman mo silang lahat, ngunit nakatayo ka pa rin! Gayunpaman, dapat kang makakuha ng sariwang hangin ngayon.
achievement.175.name: [EN] Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: Matapang kang nakatapak sa cake isle. Mayroon pa bang mas maganda at masarap na lugar sa buong mundo?
achievement.176.name: [EN] Cake Conqueror
achievement.177.description: Pinasaya mo ang isang demonyong sanggol at ibinalik mo ito sa kanyang ina. Ang isang mabilis na pagbilang ng iyong mga daliri ay magpapakita kung nagawa mo ito nang hindi nasaktan.
achievement.177.name: [EN] Baby Sitter
achievement.178.description: Pinasaya mo ang isang grupo ng mga demonyong sanggol at ibinalik mo sila sa kanilang ina. Huwag istorbohin ang mga marka ng paso, huwag istorbohin ang mga pilit ng uban, huwag pakialaman ang mga gabing gumising ka na sumisigaw. Sulit ito ... malamang ... kahit papaano.
achievement.178.name: Yaya mula sa Impiyerno
achievement.179.description: Naglayag ka sa ilalim ng dagat kasama ang Kapitan ng Ghost. Sa kabila ng mga panganib, ikaw at ang iyong mga kapwa tripulante ay nagtagumpay sa hamon.
achievement.179.name: [EN] Ghost Sailor
achievement.18.description: Isa kang peacekeeper at makinig sa sasabihin ng maliliit na tao. Nakapagdesisyon ka na at alam mo kung sino ang tutulungan at sa anong mga dahilan - at palagi mo itong ginagawa. Ang iyong digmaan ay nakipaglaban sa katwiran kaysa sa mga sandata.
achievement.18.name: Tagasunod ni Palimuth
achievement.180.description: Ilang beses kang naglayag sa ilalim ng dagat kasama ang Kapitan ng Ghost. Ang mga panganib ng nether ay naging pamilyar sa iyo at ang mga hindi karanasang manlalakbay ay bumaling sa iyo para sa payo.
achievement.180.name: Spectral Traveler
achievement.181.description: Hindi natatakot sa kamatayan o mga multo, ilang beses ka nang naglakbay kasama ang kapitan ng multo at isa kang batikang manlalakbay ng netherworld. Ang mga patay at ang mga buhay ay nagbubulungan tungkol sa iyong mga pagsasamantala nang may pagpapahalaga.
achievement.181.name: [EN] Nether Pirate
achievement.182.description: Ikaw ay isang master ng nether sea at naglakbay kasama ang ghost captain nang maraming beses na alam mo ang kanyang barko at ang mga panganib ng nether sea inside out. Tumatawa ka sa harap ng kamatayan at maaaring bumalik bilang isang ghost pirata ang iyong sarili sa kabilang buhay!
achievement.182.name: Salot ng Kamatayan
achievement.183.description: Nakatulong ka upang panatilihing nagniningas ang apoy ng mga mangkukulam. Panoorin lamang ang iyong mga daliri, ito ay mainit!
achievement.183.name: [EN] Fire Lighter
achievement.184.description: Isinakripisyo mo ang mga sangkap upang lumikha ng proteksiyon na brew ng mga mangkukulam.
achievement.184.name: [EN] Witches Lil' Helper
achievement.185.description: Nagsakripisyo ka ng maraming sangkap upang lumikha ng proteksiyon na brew ng mga mangkukulam at gumanap ng isang makabuluhang bahagi sa mga pagsisikap na itaboy ang mga kinatatakutang banebringer. Ang disbentaha ay kahit na ang mga banebringer ay maaaring mapansin ka ...
achievement.185.name: [EN] Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: Upang panatilihing nagniningas ang apoy ng mga mangkukulam, itinapon mo ang maraming kahoy na na-animate ng mga nagdadala ng bane. Maaaring mahanap ng ilan ang iyong pagkahumaling sa apoy ... nakakagambala.
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.description: Pag-ibig ... apoy! Kaya ... makintab! Dapat... buuuurrrn!
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: Ang iyong mga pagsisikap sa paglaban sa mga banebringer ay hindi napapansin. Isa kang alamat sa gitna ng mga mangkukulam at ang iyong pangalan ay ibinubulong nang may pagkamangha at paghanga.
achievement.188.name: [EN] Honorary Witch
achievement.189.description: Oh, ang saya ng pagsakay! Nakuha mo na ang iyong pinakaunang sariling bundok. Sapat na maginhawang hindi mo kailangan ng mga kuwadra, ngunit maaari mo itong ipatawag anumang oras na gusto mo.
achievement.189.name: [EN] Natural Born Cowboy
achievement.19.description: Tumalon ka sa bawat pagkakataon para sa isang hamon sa pangangaso na inaalok sa iyo at isagawa ang mga gawaing iyon nang may nakamamatay na katumpakan. Isa kang pusong mangangaso at mahalagang miyembro ng Paw & Fur Society.
achievement.19.name: [EN] Elite Hunter
achievement.190.description: Ang mga bato ay palaging nabighani sa iyo. Kaya may pagkakataon na makahanap ng isang bagay na talagang mahalaga sa loob ng isa sa kanila. Sa istatistika, dapat ay nakatuklas ka na ng ilang magagandang kayamanan sa ngayon. Ngunit muli, karamihan sa mga istatistika ay na-override ng Mother Disfortune.
achievement.190.name: [EN] Petrologist
achievement.191.description: Natuklasan mo ang mga nakatagong kapangyarihan ng Ancients - mula ngayon, tutulungan ka nila sa iyong mga pakikipagsapalaran.
achievement.191.name: Mga Nakatagong Kapangyarihan
achievement.192.description: Tiyak na alam mo kung paano ilabas ang pinakamahusay sa iyong mga kasangkapan at mga piraso ng dekorasyon. Maganda.
achievement.192.name: Gusto ko ito Fancy
achievement.193.description: Lagi mong dala ang iyong obsidian na kutsilyo at hindi magdadalawang isip na gamitin ito. Nagbalat ka ng hindi mabilang na kaunti - at mas malalaking - mga hayop at oo: kadalasan ay hindi na sila gumaganda sa loob. Ito ay sa halip dugo at dugo at lahat ng iyon...
achievement.193.name: Malalim ang Balat
achievement.194.description: Ang mga staking vampires at demons ay halos naging iyong propesyon. Siguraduhin mong makakalap kahit ang pinakamaliit na dami ng masasamang particle ng alikabok. Mag-ingat sa silicosis.
achievement.194.name: Abo sa Alikabok
achievement.196.description: Huwag kang mag-alala, walang makakaagaw nito sa iyo. Malamang.
achievement.196.name: Ligtas na Nakaimbak
achievement.197.description: Sa pamamagitan ng mga diyos! Ano iyon?
achievement.197.name: May nakalagay doon
achievement.198.description: Awww. Ang iyong sariling maliit na goldpis na kaibigan - siya ay maganda, siya ay makintab at hindi siya maaaring magreklamo kung nakalimutan mo siyang pakainin. Siguradong papasayahin niya ang araw mo!
achievement.198.name: Tahimik na Pet
achievement.199.description: Hopping, hopping through the snow - iyon ang pinakanakakatuwang paraan! Ang paggawa ng mga bakas ng paa sa isang magulo - mas masaya kung mas nagmamadali ka! Pagdila ng mga yelo sa buong araw - Taglamig, huwag nang mawawala!
achievement.199.name: Snowbunny
achievement.2.description: Lalalala... alam mo na ang himno ng kulto na kinanta sa Liberty Bay sa puso. Hindi ganoon kahirap, kung isasaalang-alang na ito ay pangunahing binubuo ng dalawang tala at paulit-ulit na lyrics.
achievement.2.name: Chorister
achievement.20.description: Pamilyar ka sa mga gawain sa pangangaso at marami ka nang nagawa. Isang maliwanag na karera bilang hunter para sa Paw & Fur society ang naghihintay!
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.200.description: Mga masasamang sumpa, masasamang salamangka - hindi ka nahihiya na parusahan ang iba sa mga kaduda-dudang paraan. May nagbigay lang sa iyo ng kakaibang tingin - ngayon nasaan na naman ang karayom ​​na iyon?
achievement.200.name: Madilim na Pari ng Voodoo
achievement.201.description: Ang tahanan ay kung saan ang iyong kasalukuyang paboritong lugar ng pangangaso, at kahit na mas mahal mo ang ilang partikular na lugar kaysa sa iba, hindi ka kailanman nakadarama ng sapat na kalakip upang talagang manatili sa isang lungsod nang matagal. I-pack ang lahat ng iyong gamit - oras na para magpatuloy muli.
achievement.201.name: Nomad Soul
achievement.202.description: Sinabi mo kay Jack ang totoo sa pamamagitan ng pagpapaliwanag sa iyo at nagkamali si Spectulus noong sinusubukang kumbinsihin siyang maging isang ganap na ibang tao.
achievement.202.name: Sabihin ang Katotohanan
achievement.203.description: Hindi mo sinabi kay Jack ang totoo tungkol sa pagkakamali mo at ni Spectulus noong sinusubukan mong kumbinsihin siya tungkol sa pagiging isang ganap na naiibang tao. Mabubuhay siya sa pagdududa hanggang sa katapusan ng kanyang pag-iral.
achievement.203.name: Hindi mo Alam Jack
achievement.204.description: Ang Combined Magical Winterberry Society ay pinarangalan ang patuloy na walang pag-iimbot na dedikasyon at pambihirang pagsisikap sa Annual Autumn Vintage.
achievement.204.name: Tagapili ng Berry
achievement.205.description: Tatlong beses mong ipinakita ng iyong mga kaibigan sa tatlong wizard ang iyong katapatan - sigurado ako na kahit isa sa kanila ay malamang na nagpapasalamat at labis na ipinagmamalaki sa iyo.
achievement.205.name: Mga Tunay na Kulay
achievement.206.description: Na-master mo na ang hamon ng Kuriks sa lahat ng posibleng hugis.
achievement.206.name: [EN] Master Shapeshifter
achievement.207.description: Sa tulong ng iyong magiliw na munting katulong, lumamon ka ng higit sa 500 tipak ng putik. Magaling, Slimer.
achievement.207.name: Mas slimer
achievement.208.description: Pinatay mo ang nagngangalit na salamangkero sa kanyang tore sa timog ng Zao. muli. Ngunit ang isang ito ay patuloy na bumabalik. Ang dimensional portal ay gumuho muli at alam mong babalik siya sa wakas ngunit hey - isang galit na galit na salamangkero, parang hinihiling ito...
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: Nakahuli ka ng limampung bihirang shimmer swimmer. Talagang sulit ang pagtanggal sa lahat ng mga bangkay na iyon sa pamamagitan ng pagtatapon sa lawa, hindi ba? Teka, hindi ba may gumalaw sa tubig kanina...?
achievement.209.name: [EN] Biodegradable
achievement.21.description: Para sa iyo, ang isang halik ay higit pa sa isang simpleng dampi ng mga labi. Hinahalikan mo ang mga dalaga at deadbeats nang walang katumbas na pagmamahal at hinarap ang kamatayan at muling pagsilang sa pamamagitan ng halik ng reyna ng banshee. Maswerte ang mga makakabahagi sa iyo ng ganoong intimate moment!
achievement.21.name: Masigasig na Kisser
achievement.210.description: Hindi mo ito tiningnan - hindi bababa sa hindi masyadong matagal... ngunit ginawa ni Groam. At pinaginhawa mo siya. Huwag mo lang sabihin sa kaibigan niyang si Dronk.
achievement.210.name: Mata ng Kalaliman
achievement.211.description: Maraming nilalang sa kalaliman ang nawalan ng buhay sa pamamagitan ng iyong kamay. Tatlong daan ang nakapasok sa kailaliman ng kawalang-hanggan. Marahil ay dapat kang matakot sa paghihiganti ng Mata ng Kalaliman.
achievement.211.name: Mananalakay sa Kalaliman
achievement.212.description: Napatay mo ang 500 na apoy ng tinik! Nandoon ka noong kinuha ng mga Firestarter ang Shadowthorn. Iniligtas mo ang araw - at ang tahanan ng ilang mga duwende na susubukan mong patayin ka. Hindi ba't ang sarap makitang naibalik ang lahat tulad ng dati..?
achievement.212.name: [EN] Firefighter
achievement.213.description: Nagawa mong pumatay ng higit sa apat na raang puting usa - mukhang isa ka sa mga pangunahing dahilan na malapit na silang ituring na extinct, way to go!
achievement.213.name: Pangangaso ng usa
achievement.214.description: Ikaw na ngayon ang royal archfiend ng Askarak, prinsipe na mamamatay-tao.
achievement.214.name: [EN] Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: Ikaw na ngayon ang pampublikong pangunahing kaaway ng Shaburak, prinsipe na mamamatay-tao.
achievement.215.name: [EN] Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: Nabasag mo ang garapon ng Horestis - limampung beses. Alinman sa hindi mo alam na takot o huwag pansinin ito. Anuman ang kaso, ikaw ay "walang takot" talaga.
achievement.216.name: Walang takot
achievement.217.description: May tumawag ba ng doktor? Naghatid ka ng 100 supot ng gamot kay Ottokar ng maralitang bahay ng Venore sa oras ng matinding pangangailangan, magaling!
achievement.217.name: Doktor! Doktor!
achievement.218.description: Malaki ang naitulong mo sa mga naghihirap na mamamayan ng Venore sa oras ng matinding pangangailangan. Kahit papaano ay pakiramdam mo ay malapit ka pa rin sa mga biktima ng pagsiklab ng lagnat. Ginagawa ka ng iyong mga damit na isa sa kanila, isang kaawa-awang kaluluwa sa gitna ng hindi mabilang na naghihirap.
achievement.218.name: Tuka Doctor
achievement.219.description: Natalo mo ang baliw na salamangkero, pinasuko mo ang nagngangalit na salamangkero - walang makahaharang sa iyong paraan ng spellweaving self-exposer. Ngunit ikaw ay lubos na hinihigop sa mahiwagang pag-aaral sa iyong sarili. Ang mismong tela na ito ay sumasalamin sa personal na pag-apruba ng magic arts.
achievement.219.name: [EN] Mystic Fabric Magic
achievement.22.description: Napatunayan mo ang iyong sarili bilang isang karapat-dapat na miyembro ng 'pamilya' at matagumpay na naisagawa ang maraming misyon ng espiya para sa iyong 'tiyuhin' upang suportahan ang mga mangangalakal ng Venorean at ang kanilang mga layunin.
achievement.22.name: Nangungunang Ahente ng AVIN
achievement.221.description: Nabasag mo ang bawat isa sa walong nakapirming paa ng Bloodweb. Tulad ng sinasabi nila: baliin ang isang binti, at pagkatapos ay ilan pa.
achievement.221.name: Arachnoise
achievement.222.description: Bumaba ka sa latian na kalaliman ng pugad ni Deathbine at mabilis na ginawa ito.
achievement.222.name: Walang-ugat na Pag-uugali
achievement.223.description: [EN] You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
achievement.223.name: [EN] Twisted Mutation
achievement.224.description: [EN] Ethershreck's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
achievement.224.name: [EN] Beautiful Agony
achievement.225.description: [EN] A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
achievement.225.name: [EN] Scorched Flames
achievement.226.description: [EN] You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
achievement.226.name: [EN] Crawling Death
achievement.227.description: [EN] You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
achievement.227.name: [EN] The Serpent's Bride
achievement.228.description: [EN] You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
achievement.228.name: [EN] No More Hiding
achievement.229.description: [EN] It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
achievement.229.name: [EN] The Gates of Hell
achievement.23.description: Girl power! Babae ka man o hindi, napatunayan mo ang ganap na katapatan at ang pagpayag na ilagay ang iyong buhay sa taya para sa girls brigade ng Carlin.
achievement.23.name: Nangungunang Ahente ng CGB
achievement.230.description: [EN] As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
achievement.230.name: [EN] The Drowned Sea God
achievement.231.description: [EN] Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
achievement.231.name: [EN] Spareribs for Dinner
achievement.232.description: [EN] You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
achievement.232.name: [EN] Breaking the Ice
achievement.233.description: [EN] Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
achievement.233.name: [EN] Just Cracked Me Up!
achievement.234.description: [EN] You've exinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
achievement.234.name: [EN] Something Smells
achievement.235.description: [EN] You've impaled the big mammoth Bloodtusk with his own tusks.
achievement.235.name: [EN] Meat Skewer
achievement.236.description: [EN] The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
achievement.236.name: One Less
achievement.237.description: [EN] You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
achievement.237.name: [EN] Hissing Downfall
achievement.238.description: [EN] The Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
achievement.238.name: [EN] Choking on Her Venom
achievement.239.description: [EN] You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
achievement.239.name: [EN] Blood-Red Snapper
achievement.24.description: Ang mga pagsasabwatan at bukas na mga lihim ang iyong pang-araw-araw na pagkain. Nagpakita ka ng katapatan sa korona ng Thai sa pamamagitan ng iyong tapang kapag humarap sa mga kaaway at pagkumpleto ng mga misyon ng espiya. Isa kang mahusay na field agent ng TBI.
achievement.24.name: Nangungunang Ahente ng TBI
achievement.240.description: [EN] You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
achievement.240.name: [EN] Back into the Abyss
achievement.241.description: [EN] You've faced and defeated a lot of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.241.name: [EN] Pwned a Lot of Fur
achievement.242.description: [EN] You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
achievement.242.name: [EN] Honest Finder
achievement.243.description: [EN] If it wasn't for you, several banks in Tibia would've gotten bankrupt by now. Keep on chasing bank robbers and no one will have to worry about the Tibian economy!
achievement.243.name: Goldhunter
achievement.244.description: [EN] You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and terrified elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
achievement.244.name: [EN] Trail of the Ape God
achievement.245.description: [EN] That was NOT a giant spider. There's some witchcraft at work here.
achievement.245.name: [EN] Someone's Bored
achievement.246.description: [EN] You can't keep a secret, can you? Then again, you're just fulfilling your duty to the Queen of Carlin as a lawful citizen. That's a good thing, isn't it...?
achievement.246.name: [EN] Whistle-Blower
achievement.247.description: [EN] Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
achievement.247.name: [EN] Torn Treasures
achievement.248.description: [EN] You joined the Kingsday festivities and payed King Tibianus your respects. Now, off to party!
achievement.248.name: [EN] Loyal Subject
achievement.249.description: [EN] You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
achievement.249.name: [EN] Desert Fisher
achievement.25.description: Pack iyong spy gear at maghanda para sa ilang mapanganib na mga misyon sa serbisyo ng isang lihim na ahensya. Naipakita mo na gusto mo - pero kaya mo ba talaga? Sasabihin ng panahon.
achievement.25.name: Secret Ahente
achievement.251.description: [EN] You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
achievement.251.name: Dog Sitter
achievement.252.description: [EN] You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
achievement.252.name: [EN] Ice Harvester
achievement.253.description: [EN] You are a pretty smart thinker and managed to create everlasting flowers. They might become a big hit with all the people who aren't blessed with a green thumb or just forgetful.
achievement.253.name: [EN] Preservationist
achievement.254.description: [EN] You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better then they can.
achievement.254.name: [EN] Chest Robber
achievement.255.description: [EN] You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
achievement.255.name: [EN] Down the Drain
achievement.256.description: [EN] You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
achievement.256.name: [EN] Fire from the Earth
achievement.257.description: [EN] Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
achievement.257.name: [EN] Minor Disturbance
achievement.258.description: [EN] In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: [EN] You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
achievement.259.name: [EN] Hive Blinder
achievement.26.description: Isa kang aspiring mago-mechanic. Mahusay na gumagana ang agham at mahika sa iyong paningin - at kahit na malamang na naghatid ka ng hindi mabilang na mga maling singil habang nagtatrabaho para sa Telas, maaaring mayroon ka lang sapat na kaalaman upang bumuo ng sarili mong golem ngayon.
achievement.26.name: Golem sa Gears
achievement.260.description: [EN] You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: [EN] Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
achievement.261.name: Heartburn
achievement.262.description: [EN] You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
achievement.262.name: [EN] Stomach Ulcer
achievement.263.description: [EN] The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
achievement.263.name: Planter
achievement.264.description: [EN] You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
achievement.264.name: Pimple
achievement.265.description: [EN] A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: [EN] By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
achievement.266.name: Gatherer
achievement.267.description: [EN] The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
achievement.267.name: Supplier
achievement.268.description: [EN] You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
achievement.268.name: [EN] Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: [EN] You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive
achievement.269.name: [EN] Guard Killer
achievement.27.description: Mga tula, taludtod, kanta at tula na binibigkas mo nang maraming beses. Nalampasan mo ang misteryosong pinto, raconteur ng sinaunang lore. Maging ang mga duwende na iniwan mo ay humanga, kaya parang talagang pinagpala ka.
achievement.27.name: Makata Laureate
achievement.270.description: [EN] The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
achievement.270.name: [EN] Hive Infiltrator
achievement.271.description: [EN] Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
achievement.271.name: [EN] Exterminator
achievement.272.description: [EN] Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
achievement.272.name: Headache
achievement.273.description: [EN] The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
achievement.273.name: Confusion
achievement.274.description: [EN] You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centers and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
achievement.274.name: Manic
achievement.276.name: [EN] Navigational Error
achievement.277.description: [EN] You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: [EN] You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
achievement.278.name: [EN] Guardian Downfall
achievement.279.description: [EN] You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
achievement.279.name: Death Song
achievement.28.description: Maaari mong pangasiwaan ang anumang instrumentong pangmusika na ibinigay sa iyo - at aktwal na namamahala upang makagawa ng isang kaaya-ayang tunog kasama nito. Malugod kang bisita at entertainer sa karamihan ng mga tavern.
achievement.28.name: Minstrel
achievement.280.description: [EN] By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
achievement.280.name: [EN] Depth Dwellers
achievement.281.description: [EN] You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
achievement.281.name: Gem Cutter
achievement.282.description: [EN] You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
achievement.282.name: [EN] Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: [EN] Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
achievement.283.name: [EN] Bane of the Hive
achievement.285.description: [EN] Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
achievement.285.name: [EN] Hive War Veteran
achievement.286.description: [EN] You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
achievement.286.name: [EN] Hive Fighter
achievement.287.description: [EN] You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
achievement.287.name: [EN] Howly Silence
achievement.288.description: [EN] No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
achievement.288.name: [EN] Dream's Over
achievement.289.description: [EN] You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
achievement.289.name: [EN] Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.29.description: Kilala mo si Banuta tulad ng likod ng iyong kamay at magaling sa pagsira ng mga casket at urn. Ang paningin ng mga higanteng bakas ng paa ay hindi rin pumipigil sa iyo na tuklasin ang mga hindi kilalang lugar.
achievement.29.name: Kaibigan ng mga Apes
achievement.290.description: [EN] This time you knocked out the big one.
achievement.290.name: [EN] Stepped on a Big Toe
achievement.291.description: [EN] No joke, you murdered the bat.
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: [EN] You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: [EN] Enter zze Draken!
achievement.293.description: [EN] Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
achievement.293.name: [EN] King of the Ring
achievement.294.description: [EN] You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
achievement.294.name: [EN] Back from the Dead
achievement.295.description: [EN] You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.295.name: [EN] Pwned All Fur
achievement.297.description: [EN] You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
achievement.297.name: [EN] Bibby's Bloodbath
achievement.298.description: [EN] You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: [EN] You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
achievement.299.name: [EN] Becoming a Bigfoot
achievement.3.name: Ang Milkman
achievement.30.description: Ang iyong mapa ay iyong kaibigan — palaging nasa iyong likod na bulsa at natatakpan ng hindi mabilang na mga marka ng kawili-wili at kapaki-pakinabang na mga lokasyon. Maaaring sabihin ng isang tao na maaari kang mawala kung wala ito — ngunit sa kabutihang-palad ay walang paraan upang kunin ito mula sa iyo.
achievement.30.name: Teritoryal
achievement.300.description: [EN] You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
achievement.300.name: [EN] Gnome Little Helper
achievement.301.description: [EN] The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
achievement.301.name: [EN] Gnome Friend
achievement.302.description: [EN] You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
achievement.302.name: Gnomelike
achievement.303.description: [EN] You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
achievement.303.name: [EN] Honorary Gnome
achievement.304.description: [EN] You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
achievement.304.name: [EN] Crystals in Love
achievement.305.description: [EN] Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
achievement.305.name: [EN] Substitute Tinker
achievement.306.description: [EN] After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
achievement.306.name: [EN] Spore Hunter
achievement.307.description: [EN] Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
achievement.307.name: [EN] Grinding Again
achievement.308.description: [EN] Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
achievement.308.name: [EN] Dungeon Cleaner
achievement.309.description: [EN] So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
achievement.309.name: [EN] Crystal Keeper
achievement.31.description: Napatunayan mong isa kang mahalagang kaalyado sa Marid, at tinanggap ka ni Gabel na makipagkalakalan kay Haroun at Nah'Bob kahit kailan mo gusto. Kahit na ang digmaang Djinn ay hindi pa rin nagtatapos, ang Marid ay hindi maaaring mabigo sa iyo sa kanilang panig.
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.310.description: [EN] Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
achievement.310.name: [EN] Call Me Sparky
achievement.311.description: [EN] One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
achievement.311.name: [EN] One Foot Vs. Many
achievement.312.description: [EN] The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
achievement.312.name: [EN] The Picky Pig
achievement.313.description: [EN] You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
achievement.313.name: [EN] Diplomatic Immunity
achievement.314.description: [EN] Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: [EN] Fall of the Fallen
achievement.315.description: [EN] Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
achievement.315.name: [EN] Death on Strike
achievement.316.description: [EN] The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
achievement.316.name: [EN] Death from Below
achievement.317.description: [EN] The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
achievement.317.name: [EN] Gnomebane's Bane
achievement.318.description: [EN] The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
achievement.318.name: [EN] Final Strike
achievement.319.description: [EN] Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
achievement.319.name: [EN] Goo Goo Dancer
achievement.32.description: Kahit na ang Efreet ay malugod kang tinanggap at tiningnan bilang "tao lamang" sa loob ng mahabang panahon, nagawa mong mapabilib si Malor at nakuha ang kanyang paggalang at pakikipagkalakalan sa mga green djinn.
achievement.32.name: [EN] Efreet Ally
achievement.320.description: [EN] Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
achievement.320.name: [EN] Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: [EN] If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
achievement.321.name: [EN] Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: [EN] You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
achievement.322.name: [EN] Gnomish Art Of War
achievement.324.description: [EN] You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
achievement.324.name: [EN] True Dedication
achievement.325.description: [EN] Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
achievement.325.name: [EN] Task Manager
achievement.326.description: [EN] Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
achievement.326.name: [EN] Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: [EN] You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
achievement.327.name: Repenter
achievement.328.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.328.name: [EN] Umbral Swordsman
achievement.33.description: Pangarap - ang iyong katotohanan? Kakaibang mga pangitain, mga orasan, pagtulog at paggising sa ibang lugar - iyon ay isang paglalakbay, ngunit halos sigurado ka na talagang nasiyahan ka.
achievement.33.name: [EN] Lucid Dreamer
achievement.331.description: [EN] You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
achievement.331.name: [EN] Cave Completionist
achievement.332.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.332.name: [EN] Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.333.name: [EN] Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.334.name: [EN] Umbral Executioner
achievement.335.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.335.name: [EN] Umbral Brawler
achievement.336.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.336.name: [EN] Umbral Berserker
achievement.337.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.337.name: [EN] Umbral Archer
achievement.338.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.338.name: [EN] Umbral Marksman
achievement.339.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.339.name: [EN] Umbral Harbinger
achievement.34.description: Nakapunta ka na sa mga lugar na hindi alam ng karamihan sa mga tao ang mga pangalan. Pang-araw-araw mong negosyo ang pagkolekta ng botanic, zoologic at ectoplasmic sample at palagi kang handang tumuklas ng mga bagong abot-tanaw.
achievement.34.name: Explorer
achievement.340.description: [EN] You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
achievement.340.name: [EN] Umbral Master
achievement.341.description: [EN] You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
achievement.341.name: [EN] Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: [EN] What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: [EN] Luring Silence
achievement.343.description: [EN] You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
achievement.343.name: [EN] Never Surrender
achievement.344.description: [EN] You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
achievement.344.name: [EN] Dream Wright
achievement.345.description: [EN] You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
achievement.345.name: [EN] Ending the Horror
achievement.346.description: [EN] You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
achievement.346.name: [EN] Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: [EN] It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
achievement.347.name: [EN] Dream Warden
achievement.348.description: [EN] Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
achievement.348.name: [EN] Prison Break
achievement.349.description: [EN] After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
achievement.349.name: [EN] Noblesse Obliterated
achievement.35.description: Kahit na ang pagalit na kapaligiran sa ilalim ng dagat ay hindi pumipigil sa iyo sa paggawa ng iyong tungkulin para sa Explorer Society. Ang pagmamanman sa kaharian ng Quara ay isang piraso ng cake para sa iyo.
achievement.35.name: Sea Scout
achievement.350.description: [EN] Through the spirit of science and exploration, you have discovered how to enter the secret hideout of the renowned Dr Merlay.
achievement.350.name: [EN] Elementary, My Dear
achievement.351.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Commoner.
achievement.351.name: [EN] Rathleton Commoner
achievement.352.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Inhabitant.
achievement.352.name: [EN] Rathleton Inhabitant
achievement.353.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Citizen.
achievement.353.name: [EN] Rathleton Citizen
achievement.354.description: [EN] You accomplished 10 or more consecutive chains in a row! That's killing at least 39 creatures in the correct order - now that's combinatorics!
achievement.354.name: [EN] Combo Master
achievement.355.description: [EN] Though you might have averted a dire threat for Rathleton, this relative peace may only hold for a while. At least you've scavenged an outfit from some of the poor fellows that have fallen prey to death priest Shagron.
achievement.355.name: [EN] Glooth Engineer
achievement.356.description: [EN] You discovered the Lion's Rock, passed the tests to enter the inner sanctum and finally revealed the secrets of the buried temple. You literally put your head in the lion's mouth and survived.
achievement.356.name: [EN] Lion's Den Explorer
achievement.357.description: [EN] Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
achievement.357.name: [EN] Seasoned Adventurer
achievement.358.description: [EN] You've got a mind ready to draw strange conclusions that defy the laws of logic and sidestep reality. Or maybe it's just a lucky guess - or adventurous recklessness?
achievement.358.name: [EN] Mind the Step!
achievement.359.description: [EN] By having rendered numerous services to the city of Rathleton you have been promoted to the rank of Squire.
achievement.359.name: [EN] Rathleton Squire
achievement.36.description: Wow - ano iyon? Hindi mo alam kung paano ka napunta dito, pero kahit papaano nagawa mo. Paano makakarating mula sa Beregar patungong Kazordoon sa isang iglap - iyon ang isang bagay na gustong malaman ng mga dwarf na iyon, ngunit hindi ka sigurado kung paano ito ipaparami.
achievement.36.name: Hindi malamang Pathfinder
achievement.360.description: [EN] He seriously stored away a wallnut? That was a nutty professor indeed.
achievement.360.name: [EN] The Professor's Nut
achievement.361.description: [EN] You have defeated the wallbreaker and saved the glooth plant.
achievement.361.name: [EN] Plant vs. Minos
achievement.362.description: [EN] You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
achievement.362.name: [EN] Rumble in the Plant
achievement.363.description: [EN] You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
achievement.363.name: Robo Chop
achievement.364.description: [EN] You escaped the glowing hot lava death trap, Professor Maxxen has set for you - Captain Caveworm is indeed proud!
achievement.364.name: [EN] Go with da Lava Flow
achievement.365.description: [EN] You saw the Crystal Gardens with all their stunning beauty and survived the equally impressive monsters there. In the end you discovered a great evil and destroyed it with the help of a banshee who was not even aware of her support.
achievement.365.name: [EN] Wail of the Banshee
achievement.366.description: [EN] You are a man of the public. Or of good publicity at least. Through your efforts in advertising the airtight cloth, Zeronex might yet be redeemed - and Rathleton might yet see its first working Gloud Ship.
achievement.366.name: Publicity
achievement.367.description: [EN] By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
achievement.367.name: [EN] Snake Charmer
achievement.368.description: [EN] Your adventurous way through countless dragon lairs earned you a pretty treasure - and surely the enmity of many a dragon.
achievement.368.name: [EN] Hoard of the Dragon
achievement.37.description: Mainit, mabalahibo at cuddly - kahit na ang parehong oso na iyong niyakap ay malamang na pirapiraso ka kung siya ay may malay, ipinaalala niya sa iyo ang lumang teddy bear na palaging natutulog sa iyong kama noong maliit ka pa.
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.370.description: [EN] You found a lost sheep and thus a steady source of black wool. But careful: don't get entangled.
achievement.370.name: [EN] Little Ball of Wool
achievement.371.description: [EN] You made some efforts to bring a little more light into the world. And what a nice present you got in return!
achievement.371.name: [EN] Luminous Kitty
achievement.372.description: [EN] By setting the right tone you convinced a crystal wolf to accompany you. Remember it is made of crystal, though, so be careful in a banshee's presence.
achievement.372.name: [EN] The Right Tone
achievement.373.description: [EN] Having a loyal friend alongside is comforting to every adventurer. If only this lad was not so stubborn...
achievement.373.name: Loyal Lad
achievement.374.description: [EN] It's not really a dragon, but rather a kind of chimera. Nonetheless a decent mount to impress any passer-by.
achievement.374.name: [EN] Dragon Mimicry
achievement.375.description: [EN] The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
achievement.375.name: [EN] Scales and Tail
achievement.376.description: [EN] There are many delusions and phantasms in the desert. You saw a false oasis with fruit-bearing palm trees. Instead of water and refreshment, however, you found a dromedary in the end. What a useful Fata Morgana!
achievement.376.name: [EN] Fata Morgana
achievement.377.description: [EN] Finding all the pieces to this complicated vehicle was one kind of a challenge. However, what you built in the end is rather a fabled than a feeble construction.
achievement.377.name: [EN] Fabled Construction
achievement.378.description: [EN] Barking dogs never bite, as the saying goes. But this one clearly tried. In the end, however, you were able to walk the dog - ahem, gnarlhound.
achievement.378.name: [EN] Mind the Dog!
achievement.379.description: [EN] This magnetic beast attracted you in a very literal way. Or was it attracted by your metal equipment? Anyway, you seem to be stuck together now.
achievement.379.name: Magnetised
achievement.38.description: Hindi mo sila hinahabol, kinakausap mo sila. Alam mo na ang mga multo ay maaaring magtago ng mga lihim na matagal nang nawala sa mga nabubuhay, at ikaw ay bihasa sa pakikipag-usap sa kanila upang ibunyag ang mga ito sa iyo.
achievement.38.name: [EN] Ghostwhisperer
achievement.380.description: [EN] Counting ten thousand grains of sand could not have been harder than gaining this impressive mount.
achievement.380.name: [EN] Golden Sands
achievement.381.description: [EN] Kingly deer mostly prefer elves as friends and familiars. This one, however, decided to favour you as a confidant and rider. Well done!
achievement.381.name: [EN] Friend of Elves
achievement.382.description: [EN] Finding a four-leaved clover is always a sign of luck. And as luck would have it, you even baited a lovely dotted ladybug. Lucky you!
achievement.382.name: [EN] Lovely Dots
achievement.383.description: [EN] This fiery beast really tried to give you hell. But not even a magma crawler can resist a mug of spicy, hot glow wine. Skol!
achievement.383.name: [EN] Way to Hell
achievement.384.description: [EN] Not really twenty thousand miles, but you had to dive a fair way beneath the sea to find your personal Manta Ray.
achievement.384.name: [EN] Beneath the Sea
achievement.385.description: [EN] By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
achievement.385.name: [EN] Starless Night
achievement.386.description: [EN] By mastering the secrets of Lion's Rock, you proved yourself worthy to face the mighty lions there. One of them even chose to accompany you.
achievement.386.name: Lion King
achievement.387.description: [EN] Ah, the old carrot-on-a-stick trick. Well done! You've made the racing bird accept you as a rider and provider. Just don't feed it your fingers.
achievement.387.name: [EN] Pecking Order
achievement.388.description: [EN] Whoa, sow long! This boar is like a force of nature, breaking through the undergrowth of all the Tibian forests and all records of speed. Hang on!
achievement.388.name: Pig-Headed
achievement.389.description: [EN] It might come as a shock to you, but this is the mount of your dreams. Not exactly the white steed of Prince Charming, but maybe the ladies will still scream and faint at the sight of you.
achievement.389.name: [EN] Personal Nightmare
achievement.39.description: Mayroon kang malambot na lugar para sa maliliit at mahihinang hayop, at ginagawa mo ang lahat sa iyong makakaya upang protektahan sila - kahit na malamang na kumain ka ng mga dragon para sa almusal.
achievement.39.name: Aktibista ng Hayop
achievement.390.description: [EN] It's unstoppable! Walls? Fortresses? Obstacles? Objections? Pah! Nothing will stand before the stampor. Arrows and spears bounce off its hide, enemies are trampled by the dozen. Just don't go for the subtle approach or a date on this thing.
achievement.390.name: [EN] Thick-Skinned
achievement.391.description: [EN] Don't let its fluffy appearance deceive you. The panda is a creature of the wild. It will take you to the most distant regions of Tibia, always in hopes of a little bamboo to nibble on or to check on a possible mate.
achievement.391.name: [EN] Chequered Teddy
achievement.392.description: [EN] Well, you can rest your nailcase now. This gravedigger's fingernails are nice and clean. Though after the next hellride, you might not want to let it hand any food to you.
achievement.392.name: [EN] Blacknailed
achievement.393.description: [EN] Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug. Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
achievement.393.name: [EN] Slugging Around
achievement.394.description: [EN] It's a wound-up wooden lizard! Well, stranger things have happened, or so you're told. Just hop on and let this wood-and-tin contraption take you anywhere you want to wind down a bit. And hope you don't get hit by lightning underway.
achievement.394.name: [EN] Knock on Wood
achievement.395.description: [EN] This must be underwater love - this enormous crustacean now does thy bidding. Or maybe it's just in it for a little more of that shrimp barbecue, as that's a little hard to come by in the sea.
achievement.395.name: [EN] Fried Shrimp
achievement.396.description: [EN] What a blast from the past! This thankful patient thinks you missed your dentist vocation. It's now ready to take a bite of the future and to carry you to your next adventure, or your next patient.
achievement.396.name: [EN] Out of the Stone Age
achievement.397.description: [EN] A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
achievement.397.name: Stuntman
achievement.398.description: [EN] Installing that control unit was a no-brainer. Now you're in control to make it walk this way or that, or to change tack at any moment if required. Your faithful walker mount obeys your every command.
achievement.398.name: Gear Up
achievement.399.description: [EN] Hunter's greeting! Your skillful use of the slingshot actually stunned a large bear. The creature is slightly dazed, but seems susceptible to your commands. Let's declare open season on all our foes!
achievement.399.name: [EN] Bearbaiting
achievement.4.description: Palagi kang rebelde - aminin mo! Pagsusuplay sa mga bilanggo, pag-aalaga sa mga itinapon, pagnanakaw sa mayayaman at pagbibigay sa mahihirap - huwag maghintay, iyon ay ibang kuwento.
achievement.4.name: [EN] Vive la Resistance
achievement.40.description: Niyakap mo ang mga oso, tinulak ang mga mammoth at napatunayan ang iyong kakayahan sa pag-inom. At kahit na mayroon kang bahagyang hangover, isang bahagyang bali ng tadyang at ilang mamantika na buhok sa iyong dila, lubos mong ipinagmamalaki na tawagan ang iyong sarili bilang isang honorary barbarian mula ngayon.
achievement.40.name: [EN] Honorary Barbarian
